## Requirements (contract § In scope)

1. **Drill mode** — PITR clone `sig-pg` → `sig-pg-drill-<STAMP>` at T
   (≈ 10 min ago); verify through the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy with a read-only
   posture on both instances: append-only parity at T for every spine table
   (`claim`, `claim_evidence`, `evidence_capture`, `evidence_artifact`,
   `entity`, `ingest_run`, `ingest_run_completion`, `resolution`,
   `contradiction`, `coverage_record`; `spine_watermark` row equal), `sqitch
   status` equal, PostGIS present, API smoke against the clone (`/health`
   200, one `/v1/coverage` call); RTO (clone start → verified) and RPO (T vs
   `max(lower(sys_period))`) recorded.
2. **Name-checked delete** — refuses any name not matching
   `sig-pg-drill-*` and refuses `sig-pg` outright (tested).
3. **Full-backup variant** — restore of the latest automated backup into a
   pre-created empty drill instance — built and dry-run-tested; its first
   run is a queued leg (the quarterly drill) on an in-ticket go or a GATE-G4
   OM-20 listing.
4. **AR-2 restore-point procedure** scripted + documented — on-demand
   backup + pre-state capture before any hosted write; bucket pre-copy or
   versioned restore point before any bucket write (FEA-07).
5. **Monthly logical export** — `gcloud sql export sql` to
   `gs://…-sig-backups/pg/monthly/<YYYY-MM>/`, three newest kept
   (lifecycle); `pg/adhoc/` expires after 30 days; the 09-15 seed dumps
   relabelled by copying to `pg/seed-2026-09-15/` + a README object
   (originals not deleted); the monthly cadence declared in
   `ops/cadence.toml` (deployed by the scheduler of record, P35.1a) and
   carried in the OM-19 queue until then.
6. **ADR-175** — Production data protection and restore drills; qualifies
   ADR-081 (`## Status updates` append, S6R-24).
7. **C-10** — the drill reads plan state only; `db/sqitch.plan` L44–52 never
   edited or re-stamped; D-P32.10a-1's `sqitch verify` defect is never
   mistaken for a restore failure.

## Live legs (contract § Live stage / OM-19)

- **Leg 1 (pre-authorised, S5-3):** the PITR drill — clone, verify, delete.
  Window: never 03:00–10:00Z, never concurrent with `sig-materialize`;
  allowed inside AR-3; ideally before 2026-10-10T03:35Z.
- **Leg 2 (in-ticket go required):** first monthly `gcloud sql export sql`
  to `sig-backups`, the lifecycle rules, the seed-dump relabel by copy.
  Outside AR-3 and outside 03:00–10:00Z (the export loads `sig-pg`).
- **Leg 3 (queued; go or GATE-G4 listing):** the full-backup variant into a
  pre-created empty drill instance.
- **Boundary leg:** the next drill is due after P34.46's schema deploy
  (SIG-OPS-001 "after every schema-changing deploy").

## Plan

1. `ops/src/ops/cloudsql_drill.py` — the parity engine + drill record
   (`DrillRecord`): per-table instant expressions mirroring
   `db/deploy/shared_temporal_contract.sql`'s watermark facet table
   (`claim`→`lower(sys_period)`, `claim_evidence`→`bound_at`,
   `evidence_capture`→`retrieved_at`, `entity`→`created_at`,
   `ingest_run`→`coalesce(finished_at,started_at)`,
   `ingest_run_completion`→`recorded_at`, `resolution`→`lower(sys_period)`,
   `contradiction`→`resolved_at`, `coverage_record`→`searched_at`,
   `evidence_artifact`→ count-all); `sqitch.changes` ordered `(change,
   change_id)` list compare (the `sqitch status` equivalent — reads plan
   state only, C-10); `pg_extension` PostGIS presence; watermark row-set
   compare; drill-instance name validator (`^sig-pg-drill(-b)?-<stamp>$`,
   `sig-pg` refused outright); RTO/RPO fields. Injectable connection factory
   — unit-testable without Docker.
2. `sig-ops cloudsql-drill` CLI verb family (`parity`) — DSNs arrive via env
   (`SIG_DRILL_DSN_*`), never argv.
3. `ops/gcp/restore-drill.sh` — dry-run-by-default orchestration:
   `prestate` (read-only captures, any window) · `clone` (window guard
   exit 42 inside 03:00–10:00Z; fail-closed `sig-materialize` check;
   flag check; newest-backup-SUCCESSFUL gate — a failed restore point
   voids; red-probe acknowledgment flag) · `counts` (proxy spawn, parity,
   RTO/RPO) · `smoke` (local `sig-api serve --dsn` over the proxy;
   `/health` + one `/v1/coverage` call) · `deleteclone <name>` (name-checked)
   · `fullrestore` (leg 3 — additionally `--go`-gated) · `all` ·
   `--verify [--from-state DIR]` (drill-record + instance-list outcome diff).
4. `ops/gcp/restore-point.sh` — the AR-2 procedure: `sqlpoint` (pre-state +
   on-demand `sig-pg` backup polled to SUCCESSFUL — the first step of any
   hosted write) and `bucketpoint` (name-checked pre-copy of the listed
   objects into `gs://…-sig-restricted/restore-point/<STAMP>/` + manifest —
   the step before any bucket write; FEA-07).
5. `ops/gcp/logical-export.sh` — leg 2, `--apply` refused (exit 42) without
   `--go "<verbatim in-ticket go>"`: `prestate` (`ls -L` + lifecycle +
   describe captures) · `export` (one `gcloud sql export sql` to
   `pg/monthly/<YYYY-MM>/`) · `lifecycle` (`pg/monthly/` age ≥ 100 d — the
   "keep 3 newest" bound under a monthly cadence; `pg/adhoc/` age ≥ 30 d —
   refuses to replace foreign rules) · `relabel` (copy the 09-15 seed dumps
   to `pg/seed-2026-09-15/` + a README object; originals kept) · `--verify
   [--from-state]`.
6. `ops/cadence.toml` — `[maintenance]` monthly-export declaration (inert
   to `sources`/`batches` parsing; deployed by the P35.1a scheduler of
   record, queued until then).
7. Docs: `docs/build/reports/GCP_DEPLOYMENT.md` appended note relabelling
   the 09-15 "drill" as seed dumps (append-only, never an edit);
   `docs/build/reports/INFRA_RUNBOOK.md` §9 (drill + restore-point +
   export procedure tables); ADR-175 + ADR-081 `## Status updates` append +
   regenerated `docs/adr/README.md`.
8. DEFERRALS: the unrun production legs as `D-P34.6-*` rows with
   `owner:`/`trigger:` + compensating control.
